_metadata.computation: Every count below is computed here from the knowledge base's own captured-Dart oracle and the frozen clinical artifacts. Mobile's figures are recorded for reconciliation and are never an input to the computation.

clinical_impact.why: The engine UNIONS additional-symptom options over the triggered tokens. A union is a set operation, so reversing the visit order changes the order options are appended in and nothing else. Every dimension that governs what a user can declare — membership, option-to-token mapping, reachable tokens, question set, roles, truncation and skip state — is identical in both orders across all 2300 comparisons.
